messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Canary deploy in prod-us-east-1 showing elevated 500s on /v1/generate. Alerting SRE oncall. https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/abc123 :rotating_light:
raj: seeing the pager, grabbing context. any recent deploy or pipeline activity?
elena: yep, we pushed a canary 12m ago from release pipeline. pipeline log shows a retag step ran after the build: `registry.redwood.io/redwood/model-service:prod-latest` was re-pointed to a new sha.
taylor: canary pods crashed with image pull errors or intermittent 503s? what's the symptom?
elena: canary pods came up but returned 502/503s. logs show model process failing during kv-cache init. other regions normal.
raj: link to the rollout: `kubectl -n models rollout status deploy/model-service --watch` showed repeating restarts.
elena: I pulled the image digests: the digest in the manifest at deploy time != the digest that ended up behind prod-latest. looks like a retag race in the CD job. output:
```
> deploy manifest image: registry.redwood.io/redwood/model-service@sha256:aaa111
> prod-latest currently resolves to sha256:bbb222
> docker inspect registry.redwood.io/redwood/model-service:prod-latest -> sha256:bbb222
```
raj: so the manifest asked for aaa111 but the tag prod-latest now points to bbb222. that mismatch could cause rollout to fetch unexpected layers or mismatch config baked into image.
taylor: can we force rollback to known-good image sha (aaa111) or pin to exact digest?
elena: creating rollback PR now and will trigger `kubectl set image deploy/model-service model-service=registry.redwood.io/redwood/model-service@sha256:aaa111 --record`
raj: also enable the feature-flag kill-switch to prevent new traffic routing to canary: `/ff toggle model_canary_route off`
taylor: applying kill-switch and starting rollback.
ops-bot: Action started: feature flag `model_canary_route` -> OFF by taylor at 2024-04-12T14:44:10Z.
oncall-sre: calling out to support for customer-impact check. Which customers hit errors?
elena: initial logs show ~1200 5xx in 12m from 3 tenants: alpha-co, betalabs, gamma-inc. severity: partial outage for those tenants.
raj: notify support to open incident pages for those customers and tag priority.
ops-bot: Rollback job triggered: pipeline #4821 -> rollback to sha256:aaa111. Watching rollout.
taylor: watching pods. new pods coming up with aaa111. healthchecks passing on readiness.
elena: can confirm prometheus metrics for error-rate on model-service canary dropped to baseline within 4m.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0412-7, severity S2, affected tenants: alpha-co, betalabs, gamma-inc. Pager closed for oncall after rollback.
raj: quick postmortem actions: 1) revert retagging behavior in CD (stop mutable tag overwrites), 2) add pipeline guard to assert manifest digest matches tag digest, 3) notify customers and offer post-incident review.
elena: will own the #1 and #2, creating follow-up tickets: CD-2302 (disable mutable-retag), CD-2303 (digest-assert). ETA EOD tomorrow.
taylor: handoff to next oncall: summarize in ops ticket and Slack thread.
oncall-sre: Handoff: all user-facing symptoms resolved. rollback completed. Follow-ups assigned to elena. Customer outreach queued to support. If anything flares, page SRE.
raj: thanks team. I'll draft the quick incident summary for the incidents channel and schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow.
elena: logs/commands I ran for audit:
```
# inspect images
skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood.io/redwood/model-service:prod-latest
# set image to digest
kubectl -n models set image deploy/model-service model-service=registry.redwood.io/redwood/model-service@sha256:aaa111 --record
```
raj: closing thread, moving to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
